FAMILY · 5 PHOTOS

Family.

I love my family and don’t know what I would do without them. My parents are a huge inspiration for me. I love being the oldest brother, even though it can mean making a few more sacrifices than the rest. One of my goals in life is to own a home and raise a small family of my own someday.

KOREA · 12 PHOTOS

Korea.

This was my favorite trip I've ever been on. I loved Korea. I’m not a big K-pop fan, but the clothing and food were my favorite parts. If I could go to Korea every year just to buy clothes, I would do it.

1 / 14
MEXICO · 14 PHOTOS

Mexico.

For a large part of my early life, I was ashamed of my Mexican heritage because I didn’t see many people who looked like me at school or on TV. As I got older, I fell in love with my roots and the history of my people. I am proud to be a first-generation Mexican American in tech. Mexico is a beautiful country with a rich culture, and I wish I could visit more often.

SEATTLE · 27 PHOTOS

Seattle.

I have some gripes with Seattle, but some of my favorite things about the city are its views. Sometimes it’s easy to forget how privileged I am to live in a place like this, and some of these photos remind me to be grateful for my home and community.
